notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. Only one tower-type listing (firelookout.com), the FFLA index and Rex's pages were found; they give location, elevation, benchmark and status, but no build date, design, staffing, fire history or description of the site now. Two searches added nothing specific to this tower. Land status is Crow Indian Reservation, and no source read says who manages the site or whether the public may visit, so an editor should not assume public access. Story is short by evidence.
